Amazon Web Services Invoice Available [Account: 000000000000] — Amazon Web Services <no-reply@tax-and-invoicing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com>, 2026-06-02

Greetings from Amazon Web Services,

We are writing to notify you that your AWS Account has Electronic Invoice(s) available. This is for usage of AWS services for billing period May 1 - May 31, 2026. Additional information regarding your bill, individual service charge details, and your account history are available on the Billing & Cost Management Page. Thank you for using Amazon Web Services.

We will automatically charge the total amount due shown above to your default payment method unless your bank requires additional verification from you.

Sincerely,
Amazon Web Services
